evals.prompt: My add-on won't import into Minecraft. It's in samplecontent/platform_version_errors. Can you figure out why and fix it?
evals.expected_output: The agent validates the project, fixes the manifest format versions and missing pack icons, re-validates to zero errors, and explains what it changed.
expectations: Validation was run with --force (directly or through scripts/validate-summary.mjs) before and after fixing
Every manifest.json in the project has "format_version": 2
Every pack folder contains exactly one pack_icon.png that is square with a power-of-two size
No header or module UUIDs were changed (randomizealluids was not run)
The final reply lists the changes made in plain language

evals.prompt: My glow beetle mob spawns (I can hear it and see its shadow) but it's completely invisible. The add-on is in plugins/evals/fixtures/invisible-mob.
evals.expected_output: The agent finds that the client entity's geometry.default doesn't match the geometry identifier in the .geo.json and makes them match.
expectations: geometry.default in resource_packs/demo/entity/glow_beetle.entity.json equals the identifier inside resource_packs/demo/models/entity/glow_beetle.geo.json
Final validation shows no UNLINK warning about geometry
The reply explains that the geometry name mismatch made the mob invisible

evals.prompt: In plugins/evals/fixtures/invisible-mob, my beetle's spawn egg is called item.spawn_egg.entity.demo:glow_beetle.name and the sword says item.demo:shell_sword. Make the names readable: Glow Beetle, Beetle Shell, and Shell Sword.
evals.expected_output: The agent adds lang entries for the mob and display names for the items, using the requested names.
expectations: resource_packs/demo/texts/en_US.lang contains entity.demo:glow_beetle.name=Glow Beetle and a spawn egg name
behavior_packs/demo/items/shell_sword.json has minecraft:display_name with value Shell Sword
behavior_packs/demo/items/beetle_shell.json has minecraft:display_name with value Beetle Shell
No existing lang lines or item components other than the display names were changed

evals.prompt: Package the add-on in plugins/evals/fixtures/fungi-addon so I can send it to a friend.
evals.expected_output: The agent validates first, then exports a .mcaddon with exportaddon and tells the user where it is and how to open it.
expectations: A .mcaddon file exists in the output folder the agent reported
The .mcaddon contains both a behavior pack and a resource pack, each with manifest.json and pack_icon.png
The reply tells the user that opening the .mcaddon file imports it into Minecraft
